description: React Router hook returning `[URLSearchParams, setSearchParams]` for the current location's query string.
`setSearchParams((previous) => next)` builds the next params from the current ones, preserving unrelated keys.
Push adds a history entry (back undoes it); `{ replace: true }` overwrites the current entry.
One URL per view: default values are omitted so equivalent states produce identical links.
Treat params as untrusted strings: validate, convert types and fall back to defaults in one function.
